notablePrerequisites: Priest of Urabrask has a sticker on it.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {B}.
Activate Scampire by paying {3}{B}, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
